challenge: Sunny, dry Sunday in New Buffalo (about 39°F early, warming to ~55–57°F this afternoon, breezy, no rain). Yesterday was upper, so today is an easy lower day: a light dumbbell leg block, then a longer walk in the best weather of the week.
items: Easy 5 min warm-up (leg swings, bodyweight squats, marches)
DB reverse lunge 2x10 each leg @ 12 lb
40 min brisk walk this afternoon (sunny, mid-50s)
Add 4x1 min easy jog intervals inside the walk (optional)
